Name: Pet House Buildables for TMX Loader
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: Allows you to build and place pet houses for your pets, no map editing necessary!
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT NEXUSMODS, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

Allows you to build houses for your pets anywhere on the map, no map editing required!  These houses do require a small amount of wood and money to build - think of them like a pre-fab DIY pack.  If you remove the buildable, you will be refunded the building cost.  Right now there are seven styles offered, courtesy of Acerbicon, Taelende/Hershel, and Pookachu.  I have reached out to the author of the other pet house sprites asking for permission to add their styles as well!

This mod requires [TMX Loader](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1820) which in turn requires [PyTK](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726).  Please see the instructions for opening the buildables menu on the TMX Loader page.

Several of these variants now require the mod they are associated with to appear - for example, the Starblue versions won't appear unless you have Starblue installed.  This is to reduce menu clutter.  The versions are also sorted into a few categories now, to also reduce clutter.

WORKS WITH SDV 1.4!

Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  Install [PytK](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726)﻿ and [TMX Loader](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1820)﻿.

3.  Copy  the  '[TMX] Pet House Buildables' folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.

4.  Run the game using SMAPI, you're done!
Known Issues

*   If there is something on the buildings layer of the map behind the bottom half of the pethouse, it will remove that section of the map.  Please avoid placing the buildables near the built in fences, etc on your maps!
